flood_zones.description: Low-lying riverside area. Regularly inundated during monsoon per KMC flood maps.
Former wetland area. Chronic flooding due to drainage issues documented by KMC.
Low drainage coefficient. Flooding documented after 50mm+ rainfall events.
Suburban drainage issues. Flood inundation documented in 2021, 2022 monsoon.
South Kolkata low-lying area with recurring flood issues near Tolly Nullah.
Recorded as high flood hazard zone in NDMA Atlas. Ichamati River overflow.
flood_zones.source: NDMA Flood Hazard Zonation Atlas WB 2020

flood_zones.description: Extremely high flood risk. Cyclone Amphan + Yaas caused severe inundation 2020-2021.
Coastal zone. Recurring flood from Ichhamati and storm surge. NDMA High Risk Zone.
Tidal flooding zone. Rupnarayan and Hooghly confluence. Very high risk per ISRO.
Coastal Sundarbans buffer zone. Among highest flood risk in WB.
Damodar flood plain. Recorded catastrophic flooding 2000, 2009, 2021.
Damodar-Rupnarayan convergence zone. NDMA categorised as Very High Hazard.
Hooghly River banks. Moderate flood risk from river overflow during high discharge.
Damodar plains. Severe flood documented multiple times. CWC red alert zone.
Jalangi River flood zone. High hazard per NDMA Flood Atlas.
Brahmaputra floodplain. Annual flooding documented. NDMA Very High Hazard zone.
Majuli is world's largest river island, frequently flooded by Brahmaputra. Annual inundation.
Manas and Aie river system. Repeated catastrophic flooding per ASDMA reports.
Upper Brahmaputra corridor. High flood risk, embankment breaches documented yearly.
Central Assam floodplain. Among worst-affected areas in annual Assam floods.
Kosi river is called "Sorrow of Bihar". Catastrophic 2008 breach displaced millions. CWC Very High Hazard.
Bagmati and Kamla river flood zone. Annual inundation documented. NDMA High Hazard.
Gandak and Burhi Gandak rivers. Recurring catastrophic flooding per CWC records.
Ganga flooding causes inundation in low-lying Patna areas. 2019 Patna flood documented.
flood_zones.source: Bihar SDMA + ISRO Emergency Flood Report

flood_zones.description: Ghaghra and Ganga confluence zone. Severe annual flooding documented.
Ganga flooding of low ghats and riverside areas. Annual CWC alert zone.
Ganga floodplain. Inundation documented 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022.
Rapti and Rohini rivers. Severe flooding documented multiple times. NDMA High Risk zone.
Ganga-Yamuna confluence. Extreme flooding during high discharge years (2019, 2021).
Ghaghra/Sharda river flood zone. Among highest flood hazard districts in UP per NDMA.
Yamuna floodplain. 2023 Delhi flood was most severe in decades. CWC Red Alert zone.
East Delhi low-lying areas adjacent to Yamuna. Inundated in 2023 floods.
Tapti river flooding caused catastrophic 2006 Surat flood. CWC Very High Hazard zone.
Narmada river. Sardar Sarovar dam releases cause downstream flooding. NDMA High Risk.
Sabarmati river flooding of low-lying areas. 2024 flood inundated parts of city.
2022 Morbi bridge collapse + flood disaster. Machchhu river flood zone. CWC High Hazard.
Mahanadi river. Cuttack is historically one of most flood-prone cities in India.
Hirakud dam releases cause downstream flooding. NDMA categorises as Very High Risk.
Coastal Odisha. Cyclone-induced flooding + tidal inundation. 1999 super cyclone zone.
Coastal Odisha. Repeated cyclone storm surge inundation documented.
Godavari delta. One of most flood-prone river systems. CWC Very High Hazard.
Krishna river flooding. 2020 floods inundated much of Vijayawada. CWC High Hazard.
Delta interfluve area. Extremely high flood hazard per ISRO Atlas.
Musi river flooding. 2020 Hyderabad floods caused severe urban inundation.
Mithi river flooding. 2005 Mumbai floods caused over 1000 deaths. NDMA Very High Hazard.
Tidal flooding and Ulhas river overflow. Documented inundation during extreme rainfall.
2019, 2021 catastrophic floods. Panchganga and Krishna rivers. NDMA High Risk.
Kuttanad is below sea level — among most flood-vulnerable areas in Asia. Annual inundation.
Periyar river flooding. 2018 Kerala floods severely impacted this zone.
Coastal flooding + Chaliyar river overflow. 2018 flood impacts documented.
Pampa river. Most severely affected district in 2018 Kerala floods.
Chambal river dam releases cause downstream flooding. CWC High Hazard zone.
Flash flood prone in Hadoti region. Documented incidents 2019, 2022, 2023.
Cloudbursts cause flash floods and landslides. 2023 Himachal floods severely impacted this area.
Beas river flooding + flash floods. 2023 Mandi floods among worst in decades.
Flash floods and Ganga surges. 2013 Kedarnath disaster zone upstream.
Jhelum river. 2014 Kashmir floods were worst in 60 years — catastrophic inundation.
